show: All-In with Chamath, Jason, Sacks & Friedberg
titel: CoreWeave Crash, AI Trade Cracks, Anthropic IPO Red Flags, Bill Gates Doomer

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts

einzeiler: AI sector jitters, CoreWeave debt stress, and Anthropic IPO prospects examined.
kurzfassung: The hosts discuss the recent market sell-off in AI neo-clouds like CoreWeave, driven by rising bond yields and credit default swap concerns. They analyze Anthropic's massive revenue numbers and upcoming IPO plans alongside debates over AI existential risk narratives. The episode also features guest Ben Horowitz sharing insights on tech bubbles, startup dynamics, and the complexities of AI infrastructure.
stichpunkte: CoreWeave and other neo-cloud stocks dropped significantly as bond yields on debt spiked and Elon Musk tweeted a critical reaction.
CoreWeave's financial model relies on isolated project boxes backed by long-term customer contracts and hardware collateral.
Despite market volatility, AI demand remains exceptionally strong, with severe shortages in compute, power, and cooling.
Venture investor Ben Horowitz notes that today's AI boom differs from the dot-com era due to overwhelming actual demand.
Anthropic reported massive Q3 revenue of $16.8 billion, positioning itself for a massive upcoming public offering.
Discussion centers on whether Anthropic should raise a larger war chest of up to $200 billion to ensure long-term compute financing.
Critique of Anthropic's safety blog posts regarding small model risks and distillation, labeling them as competitive fear-mongering.
Debate over Bill Gates's public warnings about AI safety and whether doomer narratives serve to build regulatory moats.

kapitel.titel: Comparing Current AI Demand to the Dot-Com Bubble
Anthropic's Massive Revenue and IPO Outlook
AI Safety Narratives and Small Model Concerns

clips.hook: The AI bubble may have popped a bit this week as neo-clouds got crushed.
clips.text: Publicly traded neo-cloud companies dropped significantly after debt sell-offs triggered widespread market anxiety.

clips.hook: Insurance markets priced in a coin flip chance of default for neo-cloud debt.
clips.text: Credit default swaps spiked to levels implying a probability of default of over fifty percent across a five-year duration.

clips.hook: Amazon's CEO says compute shortages extend well beyond 2028.
clips.text: Cloud executives confirm that severe shortages of available computing power and infrastructure will persist for several years.

clips.hook: Anthropic generated over five billion dollars a month in net revenue.
clips.text: Leaked financial data shows the foundational model company pulling in staggering quarterly revenue shortly after its founding.

clips.hook: Bill Gates claims AI is powerful enough to drive events causing a billion deaths
clips.text: Prominent tech figures warn that artificial intelligence represents an extreme existential danger to humanity.
